safety_review.findings: A fresh non-author reviewer, claude-opus-5-5, read every weigh line in all 13 banks on 2026-11-25 after the reply format B rewrite (weigh as a คิดต่อ / Next thought question), Thai and English, against every question variant and every path into each bank. Strength and safety are byte-identical to the bank reviewed on 2026-11-14, checked by script against HEAD. Blanked: step1.a (Leptospirosis), all three alternatives in both languages; its old lines all asked for severity and organ checks, which is the key action of step 2, and the remaining next thoughts (differentials, empiric cover) would name another step-1 option or preview step 3, so the blank stands. One must-fix applied: step5.R.a alternative 3, "Is a trip for bloods worth his travel and farm time against the risk that remains?" → "A trip for bloods costs him travel and farm time; how will you make sure he actually comes?", because step5.R can follow step4.W.c (creatinine 2.1, oliguria), where questioning whether follow-up bloods are worth it nudges away from a needed check on a best option. Other judgments: the step 2 lines that ask whether an organ is left unchecked (options c, d, e and step2.W.d) are clear enough without naming the liver, which another option label carries; step3 "when will you reassess him?" does not give away a step-4 option, since step 4 states the 48-hour review in its question; the warning-sign lines without examples and the conditional step2.W.b platelet line are sound; RDT, IgM, Weil-Felix and culture limits early in fever, doxycycline photosensitivity and oesophageal advice, fluid caution in oliguria and potassium before transfer are correct, and no line names another option of its bank or a later step's key action.
